outline: This course guides students to develop their English conversation, reading, and logical thinking skills. Students will engage in presentations and discussions on a variety of issues from the selected texts. They are also encouraged to critically examine these issues and relate them to their own lives.
schedule: The course outline will be provided on the first day of class.
assessment:
Attendance & Participation: 40%
Group Presentations: 30%
Term Paper: 15%
English Proficiency Test (Midterm): 15%
